shared_app_shell_home_and_search-01.section: Shared app shell, Home, and search
shared_app_shell_home_and_search-01.text: Home is the default workspace, with visible global search and a smart-TV-like grid of app tiles.

shared_app_shell_home_and_search-02.section: Shared app shell, Home, and search
shared_app_shell_home_and_search-02.text: `Ctrl+K` opens a compact command palette using the same local search engine.

shared_app_shell_home_and_search-03.section: Shared app shell, Home, and search
shared_app_shell_home_and_search-03.text: Search ranks tool names, categories, button keywords, and descriptions. It understands common intent aliases such as combine/merge, shrink/compress, and trim/crop, supports small typos, and accepts ca

shared_app_shell_home_and_search-04.section: Shared app shell, Home, and search
shared_app_shell_home_and_search-04.text: Search results open the matching workspace and invoke the selected action.

shared_app_shell_home_and_search-05.section: Shared app shell, Home, and search
shared_app_shell_home_and_search-05.text: Home tiles use bundled local artwork for each workspace, with favorites and pins persisted locally in application settings.

shared_app_shell_home_and_search-06.section: Shared app shell, Home, and search
shared_app_shell_home_and_search-06.text: Home keeps a local recent-files and recent-outputs list, plus a favorites-only filter so frequent files and tools are easy to revisit.

shared_app_shell_home_and_search-07.section: Shared app shell, Home, and search
shared_app_shell_home_and_search-07.text: Home accepts dropped files and routes them to the correct workspace using the same file-routing rules as shell/file-association launches, including PDF, image, media, data, office, and playlist files.

shared_app_shell_home_and_search-08.section: Shared app shell, Home, and search
shared_app_shell_home_and_search-08.text: The app now uses a lightweight workspace registry to declare supported file types and route inputs, replacing one-off hard-coded case checks in the shell.

shared_app_shell_home_and_search-09.section: Shared app shell, Home, and search
shared_app_shell_home_and_search-09.text: The shell now includes local theme controls, accessibility text scaling, and keyboard navigation shortcuts for Home, search focus, and tab cycling.

shared_app_shell_home_and_search-10.section: Shared app shell, Home, and search
shared_app_shell_home_and_search-10.text: Every major action and button exposes a centralized, searchable tooltip dictionary so users can discover controls by label, description, and keyword from the main Home search.

shared_app_shell_home_and_search-11.section: Shared app shell, Home, and search
shared_app_shell_home_and_search-11.text: The app has reusable core modules for feature discovery, search, output format names, workers, and format-agnostic navigation.

shared_app_shell_home_and_search-12.section: Shared app shell, Home, and search
shared_app_shell_home_and_search-12.text: **Custom keyboard shortcuts**: Rebind every global shortcut (Home, Settings, Find a tool, fullscreen, text-size controls) from Settings > Keybindings, with per-shortcut reset-to-default and persistenc

shared_app_shell_home_and_search-13.section: Shared app shell, Home, and search
shared_app_shell_home_and_search-13.text: **Keyboard-only Home tile navigation**: Home's app-tile grid is fully focusable and keyboard-operable - Tab onto a tile, use the arrow keys to move between tiles in any direction, and press Enter/Spac

palette_extractor_eyedropper-10.text: Copy individual hex/RGB codes or all hex codes at once for use in CSS/design tools.

palette_extractor_eyedropper-11.text: Export a visual palette strip image (PNG/JPEG) as a reusable color reference.

palette_extractor_eyedropper-12.text: **Multi-image palette aggregation**: Extract and merge dominant colors from multiple images for brand consistency, with automatic deduplication of similar colors.

collage_maker-01.text: Dedicated local Collage Maker workspace, accessible from Home and search.

collage_maker-02.text: Add multiple images and arrange them into a configurable grid layout.

collage_maker-03.text: Choose columns (1-6), cell width/height, padding, background color, and fit mode: Cover (crop to fill), Contain (letterbox), or Stretch.

collage_maker-04.text: Optional per-photo text captions rendered below each cell.

collage_maker-05.text: Custom per-cell background colors and rounded-corner masks for cleaner product, social, or board-style layouts.

collage_maker-06.text: Export the final collage to PNG, JPEG, or WEBP via a save-as dialog.

collage_maker-07.text: All compositing runs locally with Pillow - no file uploads.

collage_maker-08.text: **Preset layouts**: Side-by-side 2-up, triptych, Instagram grid (3×3), product grid (2×2), story strip (1×4), and wide panel (2×1) framing presets are available for faster composition choices with pre

collage_maker-09.text: **Reordering and watermarking**: Drag/drop image order is preserved for grid composition, and exported collages can include a subtle watermark stamp.

media_studio-01.text: Dedicated local Media Studio workspace with an embedded video/audio player and transport controls (Play, Pause, Stop, Seek Slider, Volume).

media_studio-02.text: 100% offline, local FFmpeg engine via `imageio-ffmpeg` with zero external setup or network requests.

media_studio-03.text: **Universal Format Support**: MP4, MKV, MOV, AVI, WEBM, MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC, M4A, OGG, WMA.

media_studio-04.text: **Interactive Range & Trimming Timeline**: Live start/end playhead markers for marking start/end points with precise sub-second step controls and selection duration tracking.

media_studio-05.text: **Trim & Cut**: Fast stream-copy mode (instant, lossless keyframe cutting) and frame-accurate re-encoding mode.

media_studio-06.text: **Audio Extractor**: 1-click audio track extraction from video to MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC, M4A, or OGG with selectable bitrates (128 kbps to 320 kbps).

media_studio-07.text: **Convert & Transcode**: Transcode across video containers (MP4, MKV, MOV, WEBM, AVI) and audio formats with custom CRF quality controls.

media_studio-08.text: **Compress & Resize**: One-click sharing presets (Discord/Email 8MB limit, 720p Balanced Web, 1080p High Quality) and custom scaling.

media_studio-09.text: **Mute Video**: Strip audio streams locally with zero quality loss.

media_studio-10.text: **Frame Snapshot**: Capture the active video frame at full native resolution to PNG or JPG.

media_studio-11.text: **Metadata Tools Integration**: Full audio/video tag inspection (duration, bitrate, resolution, codecs, channels, title, artist, album, genre), tag editing, and privacy metadata stripping.

media_studio-12.text: **File Converter Integration**: Convert audio and video files in both single-file and batch queue modes.

media_studio-13.text: **Subtitle Extraction & Burn-In**: Pull embedded subtitle tracks into `.srt` files and burn captions back onto a video output with FFmpeg locally.

media_studio-14.text: **Audio Waveform Visualization**: Generate a local waveform PNG preview from audio files to quickly assess energy, rhythm, and cut points before editing.

media_studio-15.text: **Local Speech Transcription**: Attempt on-device transcription from audio/video files using a lightweight local Whisper backend when available, while keeping the feature local-first and gracefully re

media_studio-16.text: **Subtitle generation from real transcription timing**: Export the timed segments from a local transcription directly to SRT/VTT, in addition to manually typed timecoded cues; existing burn-in and ext

media_studio-17.text: **Timeline Composer**: Concatenate an ordered sequence of trimmed/cropped clips into one MP4 or GIF export, with per-clip fade in/out, a shared target resolution and frame rate, an optional crossfade

ocr_studio_and_text_extraction-01.text: Dedicated local OCR Studio workspace, accessible from Home and search (`Ctrl+K`).

ocr_studio_and_text_extraction-02.text: 100% offline, local Tesseract OCR engine bundled via PyMuPDF with zero external binary or cloud requirements.

ocr_studio_and_text_extraction-03.text: Supported input formats: PDF documents (single and multi-page, scanned or digital) and all common image formats (PNG, JPG, WEBP, TIFF, BMP, GIF, etc.).

ocr_studio_and_text_extraction-04.text: Multi-language recognition: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese (Simplified/Traditional), Japanese, Korean, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, Dutch, Polish, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietna

ocr_studio_and_text_extraction-05.text: Configurable scan resolutions: Standard (150 DPI), High Quality (200 DPI), and Ultra (300 DPI) for fine print and receipts.

ocr_studio_and_text_extraction-06.text: Live side-by-side view with visual page navigation/preview and integrated text editor.

ocr_studio_and_text_extraction-07.text: Multi-format text export: 1-click clipboard copy, plain text (`.txt`), and Markdown (`.md`) with page dividers.

ocr_studio_and_text_extraction-08.text: **Searchable PDF Generation**: Embeds an invisible OCR text layer over scanned documents or images, making them fully selectable, searchable, and copy-pasteable while preserving original visuals.

ocr_studio_and_text_extraction-09.text: **Batch OCR Queue**: Process multiple image and PDF files in bulk to Searchable PDFs, Markdown, or Plain Text.

ocr_studio_and_text_extraction-10.text: **Integrated into PDF Studio**: Extract text directly with optional OCR recognition, or convert any scanned PDF to a searchable PDF.

ocr_studio_and_text_extraction-11.text: **Integrated into Image Studio**: Extract text from full images or drawn crop regions with 1-click clipboard copy.

ocr_studio_and_text_extraction-12.text: **Integrated into File Converter**: Convert images or scanned PDFs directly to Searchable PDF, `.txt`, or `.md` via OCR.

ocr_studio_and_text_extraction-13.text: **HOCR & ALTO XML Export**: Save OCR output as hOCR or ALTO XML with per-word bounding boxes so downstream indexing, document processing, or archiving tools can reuse the extracted text precisely.

ocr_studio_and_text_extraction-14.text: **Multi-column layout reconstruction**: Detect multi-column OCR flows and structure extracted text into separate left/right columns for easier reading and downstream export.

ocr_studio_and_text_extraction-15.text: **Language-pack auto-discovery**: Inspect installed local Tesseract data folders and automatically expose supported regional packs without manual configuration.

resume_studio-01.text: Dedicated local Resume Studio workspace, accessible from Home and search (`Ctrl+K`).

resume_studio-02.text: 100% Offline & Private: Master resume data, tailoring configurations, and exported documents remain completely local with zero network calls.

resume_studio-03.text: Master Resume Management: Maintain an all-inclusive master repository of roles, projects, technical skills, education, certifications, and awards.

resume_studio-04.text: Granular 1-Click Tailoring: Checkboxes at the Section, Role/Entry, and Individual Bullet Point levels to toggle inclusion per job application.

resume_studio-05.text: Section Retitling & Reordering: Move sections or entries up/down with single clicks and rename headers inline (e.g. "Work Experience" to "Relevant Experience").

resume_studio-06.text: Job Tailoring Presets / Profiles: Save tailored configurations as named profiles (e.g., "Full-Stack Lead", "Data Engineer", "Frontend Specialist") and switch between them instantly.

resume_studio-08.text: Export ATS-friendly, clean PDF documents generated via local PyMuPDF layout engine.

resume_studio-09.text: Export to Markdown (`.md`) and responsive HTML.

resume_studio-10.text: Export as a valid DOCX / Word document with a minimal, local-first template package for downstream editing and ATS-friendly distribution.

resume_studio-11.text: 1-click copy tailored plain text to clipboard.

resume_studio-12.text: Dual-column resume templates: Export tailored resumes in a two-column layout with configurable accent colors for more magazine-style or ATS-friendly presentations.

resume_studio-13.text: Version history and changelog diffing: Save job-tailoring snapshots, compare prior versions, and summarize which sections, entries, or bullets changed between profile revisions.

product_and_engineering_guardrails-01.text: No account, payment wall, ads, analytics, tracking, or hidden file uploads.

product_and_engineering_guardrails-02.text: Processing happens on-device by default. Optional model or backend downloads are disclosed, reusable, removable, and never silently send a file away.

product_and_engineering_guardrails-03.text: Every destructive operation defaults to a new output file and must explain what will be changed, flattened, removed, or lost.

product_and_engineering_guardrails-04.text: Domain operations stay usable without Qt (`pdf_ops`, `image_ops`, `converter_ops`, `metadata_ops`, and future modules) so they can be tested and reused headlessly.

product_and_engineering_guardrails-05.text: A missing optional backend should disable only the corresponding capability, never the whole app.

product_and_engineering_guardrails-06.text: Test headless operations and search behavior before expanding into higher risk document rewriting.

product_and_engineering_guardrails-07.text: A privacy statement ([PRIVACY.md](PRIVACY.md)), an open-source license ([LICENSE](LICENSE), AGPL-3.0-or-later), a contributor guide ([CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)), reproducible build instruction
